# Build a free creator media kit

> Build a professional sponsorship media kit for your channel in minutes — bio, platform reach, audience breakdown, past brand partnerships, and your rate card. Free, no signup, runs entirely in your browser. Download a shareable HTML one-sheet or copy a plain-text version for email.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
